bullets.text: In Poonamallee near Thirumazhisai, thirty people contracted dengue and a young boy lost his life, requiring close health monitoring by the office.
Avadi police successfully cracked down and arrested members of a notorious crime gang that was operating in the area.
An elderly couple staged a protest at the Avadi sub-registrar office alleging official collusion in a twenty-five crore land grab, which the office should investigate.
Due to the impact of the Murasu cyclone, north-bound trains passing through Ponneri via Andhra Pradesh were delayed by four hours.
An electricity consumer grievance meeting is scheduled to be held tomorrow at Periyakuppam in Thiruvallur.
The Ministry of Electronics and IT released indigenous foundation models under the IndiaAI Innovation Centre pillar, which the portfolio team should review.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that over fifty percent of the more than sixteen thousand registered startups in Tamil Nadu are women-led.
MeitY Secretary S Krishnan announced plans for India to develop indigenous GPU chips within twenty-four months to strengthen AI capabilities.
